Description
The 5 oz PAMP Suisse gold bar – Lady Fortuna produced by the
PAMP Suisse
is the most popular in the Lady Fortuna series of Swiss Gold Bars. Each 24 karat gold bar is beautifully designed with a rendition of “Lady Fortuna” along with the weight and fineness engraved. The lady Fortuna bar is a highly sought after collectible because of its unique design and 5 troy ounce mass. The Pamp Suisse 5 ounce lady Fortuna gold bar appeals to both bullion investors as well as collectors alike.
PAMP is an acronym for Produits Artistiques Métaux Précieux – which translates into English as “fine metal products.” Founded in 1977 by three partners – Claude Sandoz (a noble descendent), Charles Fezzi (a jeweler), and Philippe Stern (an industrialist). PAMP Suisse is the world’s largest refiner of precious metals and PAMPS’s first gold bar was produced in 1977. Pamp has grown to become one of Switzerland’s leading international enterprises, a supplier for banks worldwide as well as an important employer at its headquarters site near Geneva airport.
The 5 oz PAMP Suisse Lady Fortuna Gold Bar is an ideal way to start investing in gold bullion. This gold bar features an iconic design with 5 troy ounces of 999.99% fine gold and has been approved by the London Bullion Market Association for trade on its market.
The
5 oz Pamp Gold Bar
comes complete with an assay card which allows for authenticity verification as well as detailing all of the bar’s specifications including its weight, purity, and serial number.
.
Design of 5 oz Pamp Gold Bar
As the name of the gold bar suggests, the image of the goddess of fortune in Roman religion is present in this 5 ounce gold bar. The image of the roman goddess, Lady Fortuna is depicted on the obverse side of the 5 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar. For centuries, Lady Fortuna has been a symbol of luck and prosperity. Known for her blindfold and cloak that reveal to those who approach her their destiny, her image is found on countless coins and metals worldwide.
The reverse of this
5 oz gold bar
features the unique company’s logo which features the word “PAMP” inscribed inside four small circles followed by the term “Suisse” just beneath it. The word ‘
ESSAYER FONDEUR
’ appears in the Swiss national language as an assayer mark near the bottom. The other labels, which are arranged vertically on the reverse, include the weight and purity of the metal content as well as the unique serial number.
This rectangular
5 oz Pamp Suisse gold bar
comes with slightly round edges.
Main Highlights of 5 oz PAMP Suisse Gold Bar Lady Fortuna
Contains 5 troy oz of .9999 fine gold.
Produced by the Swiss refiner, PAMP Suisse.
The tamper-evident assay card comes with the gold bar.
The bar comes in a protective case.
Eligible for Precious Metal IRAs.
Each one of these PAMP Suisse gold bars has a unique serial number and certificate of authenticity.
Features the Roman Goddess, Lady Fortuna on the obverse side.
Features the company’s unique emblem, as well as the weight, purity, and assayers, mark on the reverse side.
